name: ridgeline-player-limits
description: Responsible-gaming eligibility: self-exclusion, cool-off and daily wager limits. **The single source of truth for player protection. Never reimplement this logic in a caller.** Self-excluded and cool-off players must not receive promotional offers (`may_receive_promotions: false`).  **Responsible-gaming eligibility**: self-exclusion, cool-off and daily wager limits. This is the **single source of truth for player protection**. Never reimplement these rules in a caller.  **Owner:** Team Responsible Gaming · **Consumers:** bets (safety net), bet-slip, promotions tooling, boost-ops agent  Two different questions, one call: - **May they wager this amount now?** → `eligible` (considers `amount_minor` against the daily limit). - **May they receive any promotion?** → `may_receive_promotions`. This is `false` for self-excluded and cool-off players **regardless of amount**.   | Player | State | Status | Use it to test | |---|---|---|---| | `P-1001` | NJ | active | the happy path | | `P-1002` | PA | active, $20.00 left of a $50.00 daily limit | `DAILY_WAGER_LIMIT` | | `P-1003` | MI | **self-excluded** until 2027-06-30 | blocked wagers, **no promotions** | | `P-1004` | NY | active | casino not available in state | | `P-1005` | NJ | **cool-off** | blocked wagers, **no promotions** |   ## Authentication  Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. **Each API has its own key**, and a key for one API is rejected by the others.  Keys are never handed out directly. Request access and you receive a **credential reference** such as `{{vault:RIDGELINE_BETS_KEY}}`. A secure access proxy (Postman Passport) swaps the reference for the real key at call time, so neither your code, your agent nor its logs ever hold the secret.  | Response | Meaning | |---|---| | `401 unauthorized` | Missing key, or a key for a different API | | `401 unresolved_reference` | A `{{vault:...}}` reference reached the API unresolved: the call skipped the proxy |   ## Getting access (credential acquisition)  1. **Find the API** in the Postman API Catalog (or the Ridgeline Sandbox workspace): **Player Limits API**, owned by **Team Responsible Gaming**. 2. **Request access** in Postman Passport: namespace **Ridgeline Sandbox**, resource group **Player Limits API**. Pick the shortest duration that covers the job and give a reason. 3. **Wait for approval** from Team Responsible Gaming. The grant is scoped to this API's endpoints (method + host + path) and expires on its own. 4. **Use the reference**, not a key: `passport whoami` shows it, e.g. `{{vault:RIDGELINE_PLAYER_LIMITS_KEY}}`. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer {{vault:RIDGELINE_PLAYER_LIMITS_KEY}}` through the Passport proxy.  There are no scopes beyond the endpoint grant. One grant per API: a key for one API never works on another.   ## Conventions  - **Base URL:** `https://<host>/<api>`, e.g. `https://<host>/bets/v1/bets`. Paths are exact (no path parameters), so access grants can match method + host + path. - **Money:** every amount is an **integer in minor units (cents)**. `1000` = $10.00. Decimals are rejected. - **Products:** `sportsbook` or `casino`. - **Players:** sandbox players `P-1001` to `P-1005` (see each API's notes). - **Errors:** JSON `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<human readable>" }`, plus extra fields where noted. - **Idempotency:** write endpoints that move value take an `idempotency_key` or are naturally idempotent (claims).  *Ridgeline is a fictional company; all data is sandbox data.*

scripts.build: tsup-node src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function fx(s,d){const dir=path.dirname(s);const c=fs.readFileSync(s,'utf8');const p=c.replace(/((?:from|import)\s*\(?\s*[\x27\x22])(\.\.?\/[^\x27\x22]+?)([\x27\x22])/g,(m,a,b,e)=>{if(/\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/.test(b))return m;const suffix=fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,b)+'.d.ts')?'.js':'/index.js';return a+b+suffix+e});fs.writeFileSync(d,p)};fx('dist/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.mts')"

author: Team Responsible Gaming
